Population of legislative districts by Region, Province, and selected Highly Urbanized/Component City : 2020 |publisher=[[Philippine Statistics Authority]] |accessdate=June 17, 2022}} |electorate = 246,909 (2022){{cite web|date=January 24, 2020 |title=Number of Registered Voters, Voters who Actually Voted and Voters' Turnout |url=https://comelec.gov.ph/php-tpls-attachments/2019NLE/Statistics/2019_RVVAV_mcoc_final.pdf |url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201216033437/https://comelec.gov.ph/php-tpls-attachments/2019NLE/Statistics/2019_RVVAV_mcoc_final.pdf |archive-date=December 16, 2020 |access-date=February 25, 2021|website=[[Commission on Elections (Philippines)]]}} |area = {{convert|1399.31|sqkm|sqmi|abbr=on}} |towns = {{Collapsible list | titlestyle = font-weight:normal;text-align:left;background-color:WhiteSmoke; | title = 2 [[Local government in the Philippines|LGU]]s | '''Cities''' | [[Butuan]] | '''Municipalities''' | [[Las Nieves, Agusan del Norte|Las Nieves]] }} |year = 1987 |abolished = 2025 }} '''Agusan del Norte's 1st congressional district''' was one of the [[congressional districts of the Philippines|congressional district]]s for the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Agusan del Norte]]. It was one of only two districts in the province in existence from 1987 to 2025.{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 25, 2021 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }} The district covered the independent city of [[Butuan]] and its neighbor, the municipality of [[Las Nieves, Agusan del Norte|Las Nieves]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 25, 2021}} The district was dissolved in 2025 following the creation of [[Butuan's lone congressional district|Butuan's at-large congressional district]], redistricting Las Nieves to the [[Agusan del Norte's at-large congressional district|province's at-large district]] as well.{{Cite web |last= |date=April 4, 2022|title=Republic Act No. 11714 - An Act Reapportioning the Province of Agusan del Norte into the Lone Legislative District of the City of Butuan and the Lone Legislative District of the Province of Agusan del Norte |url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/downloads/2022/04apr/20220427-RA-11714-RRD.pdf |access-date=May 11, 2022 |website=[[Official Gazette (Philippines)]]}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
